description: DiligenceOps: submit environmental or sustainability claims and the evidence offered for them. The signed report marks each claim supported, contradicted or never mentioned, matching figures with their units, labels such as FSC or LEED Gold and baseline or target years, with quotes. POST /api/environmental-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-terms-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

claims.description: Environmental or sustainability claims, for example "100% recycled packaging and carbon neutral since 2021". The claims as one text, which is split into parts at sentences, semicolons, commas and joining words, or as a list of up to 50 parts.

evidence.description: The report, certificate, audit or other evidence, as text or up to 200 excerpts as {source, text}. Up to 256 KB in all.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

name: wever_environmental-evidence-check
title: Environmental evidence check
